guides.title: 架構、算例與證據：NSTX-U 球形電漿研究
guides.titleEn: Architecture, examples and evidence: NSTX-U spherical-plasma research
guides.concept: 以球形幾何、診斷及可擴充物理解析NSTX-U 球形電漿研究：六個原理與架構單元、十二項可保存的分析及驗證作業，附假想量化例、來源及衍生工程比較。
guides.conceptEn: Explore NSTX-U spherical-plasma research through spherical geometry, diagnostics and scalable physics: six principle/architecture units and twelve saved analysis/validation tasks, with an assumed numerical example, primary sources and related engineering comparisons.
procedure: 在「NSTX-U 球形電漿研究」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識低aspect ratio約束。磁約束與慣性約束在時空尺度和能量輸送不同；研究裝置不是電廠。 建立約束方式與系統邊界的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是球形幾何、診斷及可擴充物理。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。畫等離子體、加熱、磁體或光學與設施邊界。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
在「NSTX-U 球形電漿研究」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識輸入與儲能budget。等離子體或target的增益只比較指定輸入輸出；全設施需另計供電、轉換與損失。 建立加熱與能量增益的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是球形幾何、診斷及可擴充物理。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。分開Q、驅動效率、熱電效率與淨電的假想預算。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
在「NSTX-U 球形電漿研究」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識球形磁場幾何。磁場幾何或光路誤差影響約束及能量耦合；平均指標不能代表所有區域。 建立磁體或光學精度的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是球形幾何、診斷及可擴充物理。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。比較誤差地圖與受影響的物理邊界。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
在「NSTX-U 球形電漿研究」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識表面power loading。熱負載受面積、時間分佈及路徑控制；延長脈衝會增加系統熱量管理需求。 建立熱排出與表面負載的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是球形幾何、診斷及可擴充物理。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。由給定假想功率與受熱面積計算熱通量。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
在「NSTX-U 球形電漿研究」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識模型與量測分離。診斷觀測和反演模型不同；有限時效或遮擋會改變控制可用資訊。 建立診斷與控制證據的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是球形幾何、診斷及可擴充物理。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。分開直接量測、模型重建及誤差條。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
在「NSTX-U 球形電漿研究」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識研究結果外推邊界。可用率、重複率、維護及能量平衡決定電廠可行性；單次紀錄不涵蓋生命週期。 建立研究裝置與電廠差距的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是球形幾何、診斷及可擴充物理。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。列研究已證明功能與電廠仍需驗證的功能表。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
procedureEn: Identify low-aspect-ratio confinement in the mentor diagram and primary sources for NSTX-U spherical-plasma research. Magnetic/inertial confinement differ in scales and energy delivery; a research device is not a power plant. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of confinement and system boundaries, focusing on spherical geometry, diagnostics and scalable physics. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Draw plasma, heating, magnets/optics and facility boundaries. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify input/stored-energy budget in the mentor diagram and primary sources for NSTX-U spherical-plasma research. Plasma/target gain compares specified inputs/outputs; facilities also need electrical/conversion losses. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of heating and gain, focusing on spherical geometry, diagnostics and scalable physics. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Separate Q, driver efficiency, conversion efficiency and assumed net power. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify spherical field geometry in the mentor diagram and primary sources for NSTX-U spherical-plasma research. Magnetic geometry/optical errors affect confinement/coupling; averages do not describe every region. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of magnet or optical precision, focusing on spherical geometry, diagnostics and scalable physics. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare error maps with affected physical boundaries. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify surface power loading in the mentor diagram and primary sources for NSTX-U spherical-plasma research. Area, duration and paths control loads; longer pulses increase heat-management demands. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of heat exhaust and surface loads, focusing on spherical geometry, diagnostics and scalable physics. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Calculate heat flux from assumed power and wetted area. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify models versus measurements in the mentor diagram and primary sources for NSTX-U spherical-plasma research. Observations differ from inverse-model estimates; latency/occlusion changes control information. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of diagnostics and control evidence, focusing on spherical geometry, diagnostics and scalable physics. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Separate direct measurements, reconstructions and error bars. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify research extrapolation boundaries in the mentor diagram and primary sources for NSTX-U spherical-plasma research. Availability, repetition, maintenance and balance affect viability; one record does not cover lifecycle performance. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of research-to-power-plant gaps, focusing on spherical geometry, diagnostics and scalable physics. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. List demonstrated research functions and remaining plant validations. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
evidence: 提交模型與量測分離的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
提交研究結果外推邊界的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
提交研究結果外推邊界的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
evidenceEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for models versus measurements.
Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for research extrapolation boundaries.

pitfalls: 常見誤判：單次最長或最熱脈衝即可證明商業可用率。
pitfallsEn: Common misconception: One longest/hottest pulse establishes commercial availability.

related.title: ITER 國際磁約束研究工程
related.why: 可遷移能量守恆、熱路、載荷與驗證證據；熱源、工作流體及安全邊界不同。
related.whyEn: Energy conservation, heat paths, loads and validation evidence transfer, with different heat sources, fluids and safety boundaries.
related.transfer: 可遷移能量守恆、熱路、載荷與驗證證據；熱源、工作流體及安全邊界不同。
related.transferEn: Energy conservation, heat paths, loads and validation evidence transfer, with different heat sources, fluids and safety boundaries.
related.difference: 本課針對球形幾何、診斷及可擴充物理；ITER 國際磁約束研究工程改以大型 tokamak 系統、低溫磁體與熱排出為架構重點，不能直接沿用幾何、邊界或產品數值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on spherical geometry, diagnostics and scalable physics; ITER international magnetic-confinement engineering centers on large tokamak systems, cryogenic magnets and heat exhaust, so geometry, boundaries and product values cannot transfer unchanged.
practice: 對照低aspect ratio約束與tokamak真空與磁場，重畫兩項工程的輸入及系統邊界。
把本課假想算例移到ITER 國際磁約束研究工程，列出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以研究結果外推邊界為起點，設計一項能區分「球形幾何、診斷及可擴充物理」與「大型 tokamak 系統、低溫磁體與熱排出」的觀測，註明不確定度。
practiceEn: Compare low-aspect-ratio confinement with tokamak vacuum/magnetic fields and redraw inputs and boundaries.
Transfer the assumed example to ITER international magnetic-confinement engineering, separating reusable equations from respecified parameters.

Start from research extrapolation boundaries and propose an observation distinguishing spherical geometry, diagnostics and scalable physics from large tokamak systems, cryogenic magnets and heat exhaust, including uncertainty.
